name: 24-7PressRelease
summary: Press release distribution service running since 2004, paid per release, from a post on its own news site up to national wire distribution through PR Newswire.
best_for: small businesses, authors and local firms that send an occasional announcement and want a fixed per-release price instead of a PR subscription
skip_if: you need guaranteed media coverage or journalist relationships, or you only want to tell your existing customers
honest_knock: Every release is paid separately, from $29 to $479, and the pricing page describes each plan in a single line; the comparison page linked from it returned 'Page Not Found' when we read it. The $29 Simple Post is not distribution at all, only a post on their own site, and only the $479 plan names PR Newswire. A wire release puts your text in front of outlets; it does not guarantee coverage. We have not sent a release through 24-7PressRelease ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Simple Post · one-off, per release, posted on their own site only
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-08 on 24-7pressrelease.com/pricing, USD, prices per release) Six plans, each paid per press release rather than by subscription. Simple Post is $29 and adds your news to their own website only, with no additional distribution. Visibility Boost is $49, described as structured regional online distribution. PR Network Plus is $89 and expands digital distribution for regional reach. Integrated Media Pro, marked most popular, is $139 and adds digital and traditional media distribution. Integrated Media Pro+, marked best value, is $199 and extends distribution across US and Canadian media networks. Mass Media Visibility is $479 and is the only plan that names PR Newswire, for national and extended digital distribution. Each plan has a one-line description and a 'View Plan Details' link; the comparison page linked from the pricing page returned 'Page Not Found' when we read it. The site also lists an agency discount program and writing services, without prices on the pricing page. The home page says the service has run since 2004 and promises publication within 24 hours.

compare_with.name: GetResponse
compare_with.why: GetResponse is in our dossiers too, as email marketing. If your news is for people who already know you, an email to your own list reaches them for the cost of a plan; a paid wire release is for reaching news sites and newsrooms you do not have a list for.
